goal: Fix parseDuration in src/duration.mjs. A duration is one or more groups of a whole number followed by a unit h, m or s, with nothing else: "1h30m" is 5400 seconds, "2m5s" is 125, "45s" is 45. Any other input (empty string, "abc", "5x", "10", "1h30", "1.5h") must throw a RangeError. Add tests for these cases to test/duration.test.mjs. node --test must pass.

tasks.title: Fix parseDuration and test it
criteria: parseDuration sums one or more <whole number><h|m|s> groups: "1h30m" is 5400, "2m5s" is 125, "45s" is 45.
Any other input ("", "abc", "5x", "10", "1h30", "1.5h") throws a RangeError.
test/duration.test.mjs covers combined groups and the invalid inputs.
